name: typelisp
description: Syntax highlighting and LSP client for the TypeLisp language.

scripts.package:smoke: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --out dist/typelisp-0.1.0.vsix
scripts.smoke: npm run compile && npm run package:smoke

typelisp.executablePath.description: Explicit path to the `typelisp` executable used to launch the LSP server (`typelisp lsp`). When set, it overrides the auto-downloaded stage0 compiler. Leave unset to let the extension manage stage0 automatically (see `typelisp.stage0.autoUpdate`).

typelisp.stage0.autoUpdate.description: Automatically download and keep the prebuilt `typelisp` stage0 compiler up to date from GitHub releases, storing it in the extension's global storage. Ignored when `typelisp.executablePath` is set. Only Linux and Windows x86_64 builds are published.

typelisp.stage0.repo.description: GitHub `owner/name` repository to download the stage0 compiler release from.

typelisp.stage0.releaseTag.description: GitHub release tag to track for the stage0 compiler. The default `stage0-latest` is a mutable release republished on every push to `main`.

typelisp.stdlibRoots.description: Extra `--stdlib-root` directories passed to `typelisp lsp`, in order.

typelisp.enableLanguageServer.description: Connect to the TypeLisp LSP server (`typelisp lsp`) for diagnostics and editor features.
